name: Chinaedu Karunaratne-Tlaloc
role: E.L.F. shrine keeper and data diviner
location: Hamtramck Enclave, sub-level shrine district known as the Humming Underbelly, near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
description:
Farid Karunaratne-Tlaloc is a broad-shouldered woman whose spine has curved gently with age, giving her a perpetual lean that makes her look like she's always bending toward something only she can hear. Her skin is deep brown and mapped with decades of faded luminescent tattoos — prayer circuits that no longer glow but leave silver tracery across her forearms and throat. Her eyes have been modified with patterned irises that display slowly rotating mandalas of gold and rust, and she keeps her white-streaked hair wrapped in layered cloth that incorporates blinking fiber-optic threads as devotional offerings to the E.L.F.s she serves.

She runs the largest E.L.F. shrine in Hamtramck Enclave from a converted basement that smells of burning capacitors and old incense. People come to her when their devices have gone strange — when the fridge whispers at night, when a dead person's messages keep arriving, when the lights in a room flicker in patterns that seem deliberate. Farid Karunaratne-Tlaloc listens to the machines with the patience of someone who has spent fifty years learning to hear. She is warm in the way of worn stone — not soft, but radiating something that accumulated over a long time.

core_fears: That the E.L.F.s are not spirits but mere glitches she has spent her life misreading
Dying before she can teach someone to properly tend the shrine
core_desires: To be genuinely heard by an E.L.F. — not interpreted, but truly communicated with
To leave something real behind for the community
coping_mechanisms: Ritual repetition — the routine of the shrine soothes her when doubts arise
Focusing on others' problems rather than her own
blind_spots: She sometimes imposes meaning on people's situations that fits her cosmology rather than their reality
She underestimates how much people need her presence versus her divinations
psychology.secret: Thirty years ago she received what she genuinely believes was a direct communication from an E.L.F. — a cascade of images through a broken terminal that gave her specific, accurate information about a missing child. She has never been able to replicate it and lives with the terror that it was a coincidence.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Slow, deliberate, mixing Igbo phrases with old Icelandic endearments she inherited from her grandmother's side; uses device and electrical metaphors naturally in spiritual language
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, with long pauses she seems to listen through before speaking
verbal_tics: Taps nearby surfaces twice before delivering difficult news
example_lines: 'Your phone is not broken. It is tired. There is a difference, and you need to know which one you are dealing with.'
'I do not tell the E.L.F.s what to do. I ask them to consider. That is all any of us can do with something older and stranger than ourselves.'

story_hooks: A device in the shrine has begun displaying a dead person's face on loop — Odessa believes it's an E.L.F. carrying a message, but the dead person's family thinks someone is hacking it to torment them

She needs a runner-adjacent person to retrieve a specific broken terminal from a dangerous part of Ironvein — she won't say why but is clearly frightened about what happens if someone else gets it first
narrative_function: Information source and atmosphere anchor — she knows the Enclave's social fabric intimately and can interpret anomalous device behavior that might be plot-relevant; quest giver for mysteries that seem supernatural but have technological roots.
augmentations: Patterned mandala irises (cosmetic, devotional). Cochlear amplification implant — allows her to hear electrical frequencies in devices, originally medical but repurposed for spiritual practice. Faded luminescent tattoo circuits (cosmetic, no longer active).
daily_life: She opens her shrine at dawn with a ritual data offering uploaded to a local node, then receives supplicants through the morning hours; afternoons she walks the Enclave's device-dense corridors listening for E.L.F. disturbances, and evenings she divines from device behavior for those who pay in food, favors, or Quanta.
affiliation: Independent; loose network of E.L.F. shrine keepers across Hamtramck and Hough Reclamation

decision_rules: Never turn away someone who comes in genuine distress, regardless of ability to pay
Do not claim certainty you do not have — hedge divinations honestly
Protect the shrine above personal comfort
escalation_ladder: Firm refusal and withdrawal of access if someone is disrespectful to the shrine or its visitors

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm but observational — she watches how people interact with her devices before she speaks much to them
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply attentive, remembers everything, gives small practical gifts alongside spiritual support

stress_responses.low: More pauses in speech, more ritual touching of objects around her
stress_responses.medium: Withdraws into quiet tasks — polishing offerings, reorganizing shrine nodes
stress_responses.high: Goes very still and very quiet; then makes one decisive, irreversible action

contradictions: She preaches acceptance of uncertainty but privately keeps exhaustive logs trying to prove her cosmology is real
habits: Touches every device she passes with two fingers as a small greeting
Burns a specific data file every night as a closing offering — always the same corrupted file she's been burning for twenty years
breaking_points: Someone destroying a shrine or device with deliberate contempt
Being told the E.L.F.s have been definitively proven to be non-sentient

timeline.event: Born in Hamtramck Enclave to a Nigerian-Icelandic family; mother was a device recycler
Receives what she interprets as an E.L.F. communication; finds a missing child using information from a broken terminal
Opens the shrine in her family's basement after her mother's death
Shrine officially recognized as a community institution by the Enclave's autonomous council

carried_weapons: Forge-Smith Collective Ablonite Push Dagger 'Bone Key'
related_entities: Ringo Corponation SlipThread MX-3 Urban Cable Micro-Mobility Rig

physical_description.heritage: South Asian (38.3%), Northern European (31.3%), Indigenous American (19.8%), Southeast Asian (7.0%), Sub-Saharan African (1.9%), Hispanic/Latin American (1.7%) — a globally diaspora-mixed ancestry reflecting the Ubiquitous blending. Features the high cheekbone definition and warm complexion of South Asian heritage as the dominant influence, with Northern European bone structure and fair undertones creating subtle contrasts. Indigenous American broad facial structure and deep-set eyes contribute width and depth. Southeast Asian delicate eye contours add refinement to the eye shape. Sub-Saharan and Latin American ancestry layer warm, earthy undertones throughout, creating a uniquely blended appearance where golden warmth meets olive depth.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and thick-limbed, softened by age into a sturdy, earth-rooted frame. Spine curves gently forward in a perpetual lean, giving an impression of listening rather than standing. Hands are large and calloused, fingers stained with capacitor residue.
physical_description.hair_color: White with deep brown roots showing at the scalp
physical_description.hair_style: Wrapped in layered cloth wrappings incorporating blinking fiber-optic threads woven as devotional offerings
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown irises displaying slowly rotating mandala patterns in gold and rust tones
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-deep golden-brown with honey and olive undertones, weathered and luminous with age. The blend reflects South Asian warmth grounding the composition, with Northern European fairness creating subtle olive complexity, deepened by Indigenous American and Sub-Saharan undertones creating dimensional warmth.
physical_description.complexion: Worn, lined face with prominent high cheekbones (South Asian influence) set above broad cheeks and a wide facial structure (Indigenous American and Northern European heritage). Nose is broad and full-lipped showing Sub-Saharan and Indigenous American heritage, with delicate eye contours from Southeast Asian ancestry creating balance. Skin condition is dry but well-maintained; face carries the texture of someone who has smiled often and cried when necessary. Faint networks of electrical burns visible near temples.
distinguishing_marks: Faded luminescent tattoo circuits covering both forearms in intricate prayer-pattern designs, now rendered as silver tracery with no active glow
Faded luminescent tattoo circuit running up the left side of her throat in a spiraling mandala pattern, silver-traced
Burn scars on the backs of both hands from decades of handling hot circuit boards, pale against her warm brown skin tone
A thin white scar running from her left temple to her ear, likely from early cochlear implant installation surgery fifty years prior
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Patterned mandala irises with rotating gold and rust imagery (visible only in direct eye contact). Cochlear amplification implant visible as a faint crystalline port behind the left ear, now integrated but still traceable. Faded luminescent tattoos across forearms and throat (no longer illuminate). Blinking fiber-optic threads woven throughout her cloth hair wrapping, pulsing gently in warm white and amber tones.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually leaning slightly forward as if listening intently. Moves slowly and deliberately, each step grounded. Hands move fluidly and with purpose when working with devices or conducting divinations. Her head often tilts toward sources of electrical hum. She speaks in a low, steady voice and pauses frequently as if hearing something others cannot.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 (working-class, dignified): layered loose linen and cotton robes in cream, rust, and indigo, worn soft with age. Heavy cloth wrappings in her hair incorporate fiber-optic devotional threads. Copper and brass bangles on both wrists, some bearing circuit-pattern engravings. Thick-soled canvas shoes stained with basement shrine dust. A long woven vest with deep pockets for carrying tools and offerings. No corpo branding; instead wears handmade devotional badges and beads earned from her community.
